## Scope
- Which tentacle / locomotion / grabbing / damage behavior changes?
- Is the change physics-authoritative or presentation-only?

## Prototype validation
- [ ] Project boots/parses in Godot 4.7.1 when project files exist
- [ ] Deterministic reset still restores the initial state
- [ ] Eight tentacle instances/state machines remain inspectable when applicable
- [ ] No external art asset is required for core behavior

## Product thesis guard
- [ ] Change improves tentacle movement/interactions before adding progression/lore/large-world scope
- [ ] Physics authority remains separate from presentation
- [ ] No fake claim of soft-body realism beyond the implemented model

## Delivery safety
- [ ] No auto-merge, deployment, secret, permission, or billing change

## Evidence
Include exact controls, validation commands, debug screenshots/logs, and known physics limitations.
